# Kinslow Regulatory Archive & Consumer Defense Platform
> Comprehensive evidence archive, regulatory filings, and interactive dispute assistance for BNPL and Affirm consumer credit irregularities.

## Overview
- Title: Kinslow Regulatory Archive
- Author: Charles W. Kinslow IV, J.D., Licensed CPA
- Canonical URL: https://kinslow-regulatory-archive.org/
- Alias: https://bypassbots.org/
- Regulatory Focus: CFPB Consent Orders, Federal Dockets, NY AG Actions, BNPL Merchant Dispute Rights, FCRA/EFTA Compliance

## Key Documentation & Endpoints
- [Home & Diagnostic Tool](https://kinslow-regulatory-archive.org/): Interactive eligibility checker, regulatory citation finder, and consumer dispute drafting suite.
- [Telemetry Investigation](https://kinslow-regulatory-archive.org/articles/feeding-the-ai-pr-machine-unfiltered-mobile-telemetry.html): Feeding the AI PR Machine: Unfiltered Mobile Telemetry, Codebase Audits, and the Real Economy. Forensic analysis comparing corporate AI marketing claims against raw mobile call logs and GitHub commit forensics.
- [Sitemap](https://kinslow-regulatory-archive.org/sitemap.xml): Full machine-readable URL hierarchy.
- [Evidence Dockets](https://kinslow-regulatory-archive.org/#dockets): CFPB public dockets, civil litigation exhibits, and merchant refund dispute documentation.
